bases.name: Fossilised Spirit Shield
bases.notes: Popular caster base for spell-focused shields due to high energy shield.
craft_tips: Use Perfect Fossils to target 28%+ quality before beginning expensive attempts.
Consider Hillock in Research for 28% quality or higher if you have Betrayal safehouse access.
Apply 4-socket recipe in Delve to enable Fossil crafting setups.

bases.name: Vaal Regalia
bases.notes: High ES base commonly used for endgame casters.
craft_tips: Use Dense Fossils to scale pure ES rolls if not chasing specific influenced modifiers.
Bench craft +% Quality (Armourer's) after finishing prefixes.
Keep an open suffix for crafting % increased Energy Shield or +attributes.

affixes.name: +1 to Level of all Spell Skill Gems
methods: Influence-specific: Shaper or Crusader base required
Use Awakener's Orb to combine with another influenced modifier
Harvest Augment Caster guarantees the mod if open prefix
affixes.notes: One of the strongest prefixes for spell builds, very rare naturally.

affixes.name: +(60-74) to maximum Energy Shield
methods: Delve Fossils: Dense Fossil heavily weights ES prefixes
Essence of Woe (Screaming or higher) guarantees a high tier ES roll
Bench craft as a temporary filler if crafting prefixes last
affixes.notes: Prioritize Dense Fossils or high-tier Essence of Woe for deterministic results.

affixes.name: +(46-48)% increased Spell Damage
methods: Fossils: Aetheric + Metallic Fossils increase caster prefix weighting
Harvest Reforge Caster for increased odds
Alteration spam on magic shield, Regal once prefix hits
affixes.notes: Common prefix for caster shields, easier to obtain than gem level mods.

affixes.name: +(35-37)% increased Effect of Non-Damaging Ailments
methods: Harvest Augment Caster adds the mod when suffix open
Harvest Reforge Caster with suffixes cannot be changed to target
Fossils: Frigid + Metallic can roll it on appropriate bases
affixes.notes: Synergises with builds that rely on chill, shock, or brittle effects.

affixes.name: +(38-42)% to Lightning Resistance
methods: Harvest Reforge Chaos/Defence keeps the Lightning Resistance suffix
Bench craft until better resist is found
Essence of Wrath guarantees a Lightning Resistance suffix
affixes.notes: Use the crafting bench as a stopgap if chasing more premium suffixes.

affixes.name: +(17-19)% chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments
methods: Harvest Augment Defence adds the mod if open suffix
Eldritch Ichor (Searing Exarch) implicit can roll similar effect
Veiled modifier from Betrayal (Aisling) upgraded for higher values
affixes.notes: Pair with other ailment avoidance sources to reach 100%.
